diagram_previews.alt: Oblique sketch of a right circular cone with apex V and base radius 6 (blue segment from the centre of the base). A red circle, drawn as an ellipse with its back half dashed, is the cross-section parallel to the base; its blue radius is labelled 4. A grey dashed axis runs from the base centre to V, and dimension arrows on the left mark 3 from the base to the cross-section and 6 from the cross-section to the apex.

difficulty_rationale: A routine procedure with a little reasoning.
